div.font:
• SOE, EAE and HRGE are separate Qwen3-4B + QLoRA models.
• KG records are serialized into prompts; there is no graph neural network.
• EVGE, CFE and PGE are deterministic filters/compositions.
• Logical parallelism is shown; one-GPU execution is sequential.
